notes.title: Railroads and Catacombs 1.0 Launch!
notes.content:
[h1]1.0 Is Finally Here![/h1]
Hellow Travelers!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39767884/bc38af361ba0acafa3b1a5fd2f5e3f1a592f1a40.gif[/img]

After about a year and a half, [b]Railroads & Catacombs is finally leaving Early Access[/b]. I want to give you a [b]summary of all the content[/b] added to the game so far:


[h1]1.0 Update Content[/h1]

[h2]Journey to the Labyrinth[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39767884/2bc372a2611a4ff7d78a4c002bd5a28389999d07.png[/img]
Complete story of the journey to the Labyrinth, told in 10 chapters.

[h2]Caldigar City[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39767884/b47464563fba2e2a6960a066e5ada46ff3626859.png[/img]
The ancient city of Caldigar — legend has it that it lies at the heart of the Labyrinth. Explore this brand-new area and lose yourself in its eerie streets and shadowy alleys.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39767884/e2fb295e4694133c0bd274fad81729fd775471f8.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39767884/218b01a0cc2ac0d3d1b55eae1ce5f0cf77ab7cc6.png[/img]

[h2]Final Boss Added[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39767884/c0aadd640c684cae017988ceaa184057cab5a24a.png[/img]
The final piece of the journey’s story—the one that gives meaning to it all. A fearsome final boss with several new mechanics, the ultimate challenge in Railroads & Catacombs!

[h2]Story & Lore Compendium[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39767884/86da9b07aef0e1b63ef31645ff9c11f18f464780.png[/img]
An extended War Book, letting you explore the complete story and rich lore behind the game.

[h2]Steam Achievements![/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39767884/a103465c05bbcad09365407911dd2a700ad85723.png[/img]
60 Steam Achievements are now live! Unlock rewards by conquering challenges, defeating bosses, and exploring every corner of the game.



[h1]0.9 Update Content[/h1]

[h2]New Class, the Psychiatrist[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39767884/a730453b5ab4792154c0be98d6d25c00c0678c2f.jpg[/img]
The Psychiatrist joins the roster of classes. In the Labyrinth your men's Sanity hangs by a thread, and the Psychiatrist has arrived to either restore it or shatter it completely. The choice is yours.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39767884/067f2c3e6c27bf5c147bddcd69ac15df3abe6fda.jpg[/img]
His primary ability is Self Therapy. He is the only character immune to the Sanity mechanic and will always be in a Lucid state. Therefore, he cannot be the patient of another Psychiatrist, and Madness will never develop within him.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39767884/5d9fb6674af8c310761936c55f68e7a37d33705f.jpg[/img]

[h2]New Carriage, the Mental Care Cabin[/h2]
The new carriage serves as the Psychiatrist's workspace, where they will attempt to twist the minds of your men through agonizing therapies, seeking to unleash their inner madness.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39767884/7b995ac66d3f5c311f833d275155204d554efc93.jpg[/img]

[h2]New game mechanic, Madness[/h2]
A new mechanic allows you to induce Madness in your characters, turning them into powerful but unstable units.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39767884/dbfaed0ffa73623ea9ea5aebfded2511cfcfe08f.jpg[/img]

Mad characters have permanent 0 Sanity, increased damage, and higher loot, but they're always in Hysterical state.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39767884/589b858bdaab06e4ed9fbc34047c26123cbd17ac.jpg[/img]

This is perfect for new recruits who need a damage boost, but be careful, as Mad characters are prone to dying quickly.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39767884/740658471a7bd8dec998314112aabc2963629360.jpg[/img]



[h1]0.8 Update Content[/h1]

[h2]3 New Bosses[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39767884/57ca306761242bee7f6b3fbf93c84a3d19d3274a.jpg[/img]
3 new bosses will be unlocked once you have unlocked the first 6. These new bosses are late game content, so you will need to prepare your characters very well before facing them.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39767884/433462c5f40ae50d4565ec773c95fb6941c8fa75.jpg[/img]

[h2]New Biome[/h2]
These three new bosses come with a new biome that has been designed and hand-painted in great detail to recreate the dark world of Railroads & Catacombs in the best possible way.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39767884/f71633410d03d0811d9d7bdeac13fce35074c162.jpg[/img]

[h2]Train Menu HUD Improvement[/h2]
Small buttons have been added to the train's menu to make it easier to navigate to each car. This way, you won't have to walk the entire length of the train from one end to the other, which could be a bit annoying when you have all the cars built. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39767884/99cf6d4a4a5be3278db13ffa8d3b54e4dd1fbc2b.jpg[/img]
In addition, these buttons have been grouped by type to make it clear which cars improve the train, which cars improve the characters, etc.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39767884/fbd5508dba9250e6e27418d1fd7616958fca8805.jpg[/img]

[h2]New Scholar Special Skill[/h2]
The Scholar's special ability has been changed. It is now the only class that can have a deck with a minimum of 5 cards. Remember that in the last update, the minimum number of cards for all characters was increased. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39767884/00b7f8a7c1147b51d46cca834e46112595ad8d0d.jpg[/img]



[h1]0.7 Update Content[/h1]

[h2]New Deck archetype system: 15 New Subclasses[/h2]
Some of you have told me that the characters' decks didn't differentiate enough. And to some extent, that was true because their cards were random. So you could see the same cards repeated in various characters who shared the same Warpath.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39767884/b18fc4441eb4cb5c6e0d5f1fb70cf1753fec9f6b.jpg[/img]

What I've done is define each subclass, that is, each combination of Warpaths with a predefined and distinct deck that, on its own, offers a different way of playing from the start.

The game has 6 Warpaths, each offering a different combat style. This results in 15 different combinations, leading to 15 distinct Subclasses.

[h2]New War Book[/h2]
It´s a compendium with all the upgrade of the game and all the Subclasses. You can check it whenever you want to search info about all Warpaths and its mechanics. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39767884/461ac360418bb07430d97bf9a553326c736e65d5.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39767884/4e3322b55227c04fc5384b2db018cbbb82116527.jpg[/img]

[h2]New objectives in the boss panel[/h2]
You start with 4 Subclasses and can unlock the rest by defeating specific bosses at specific levels.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39767884/baad800725f90f88d954b042fbf5aff2ef76d3e0.jpg[/img]




I’ve worked [b]alone[/b] on development for [b]9 years[/b] to get to this point, but I couldn’t have done it without [b]your support[/b]. And I want to say [b]this isn’t the end[/b] — I’ll keep expanding the game with [b]new updates[/b] and listening to the [b]community [/b]to make [b]Railroads & Catacombs[/b] a truly unique experience! Exciting new things are coming!

notes.title: 1.0 Launches on June 7th & Price Increase
notes.content:
[h3]Hey Travelers, [/h3]

We’ve got some exciting news to share—Railroads & Catacombs is officially launching out of Early Access on June 7th, 2025! 🥳

As we approach version 1.0, I wanted to give everyone a heads-up:
[h3]Starting June 7th, the price of the game will increase from $16.99 to $19.99 USD.[/h3]

Until then, you can still grab the game at its current price—and yes, we’ll be running one final discount before the price goes up. 

From April 10 to April 17 (PDT), the game will be 25% off during our limited-time sale. Don’t miss it!

[h3]Why the price increase?[/h3]

With the arrival of version 1.0, a bunch of new content is on the way!
Thanks to your support, we’ve already released three major updates as part of the roadmap, and one more is coming with the full release.

Here’s a quick recap of what’s been added so far:

Update content 1: Introduced the Maze system, added new boss fight objectives, the War Book, Train logs, and 15 new subclasses.

Update content 2: Brought in Mutated Bosses, a new biome, new enemies, and train HUD improvements.

Update content 3: Introduced the Psychiatrist new class, the Mental Care Cabin carriage and the Madness game mechanic.

Not to mention countless improvements, tweaks, and bug fixes along the way…

The 1.0 launch will include another major content update—I’ll be sharing more details soon.
But even after that, the journey isn’t over. I’ll be revealing the post-1.0 roadmap and continuing to refine and expand the game. There's still so much I want to bring to life!

I'm pouring everything into making version 1.0 the best it can be, and I hope you’ll enjoy what’s coming.
If you have any thoughts, suggestions, or just want to chat about the game, feel free to hop into the Discord and say hi!

Thanks again for being part of this adventure 💙

notes.title: Labyrinth Update!
notes.content:
Hellow Travelers!

[h2]New Major Update! (v 0.7)[/h2]
It's been approximately a month and a half since the game was released in Early Access, and today I bring you the first major game update: [b]Labyrinth[/b]. Let me give you a summary of the content:


[h2]Lore: Train Logbook[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39767884/d5241c583447dcb70f2d090275cbb39844d164f0.jpg[/img]

I bring a piece of the Railroads & Catacombs world. After each expedition, you´ll be able to see a new anotation on this logbook. This will help you to understand the goal of your journey through this hell named The Labyrinth, and all the  weird things sorround this dark place.


[h2]New Deck archetype system: 15 New Subclasses[/h2]
Some of you have told me that the characters' decks didn't differentiate enough. And to some extent, that was true because their cards were random. So you could see the same cards repeated in various characters who shared the same Warpath.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39767884/b18fc4441eb4cb5c6e0d5f1fb70cf1753fec9f6b.jpg[/img]

What I've done is define each subclass, that is, each combination of Warpaths with a predefined and distinct deck that, on its own, offers a different way of playing from the start.

The game has 6 Warpaths, each offering a different combat style. This results in 15 different combinations, leading to 15 distinct Subclasses.


[h2]New War Book[/h2]
It´s a compendium with all the upgrade of the game and all the Subclasses. You can check it whenever you want to search info about all Warpaths and its mechanics. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39767884/461ac360418bb07430d97bf9a553326c736e65d5.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39767884/4e3322b55227c04fc5384b2db018cbbb82116527.jpg[/img]


[h2]New objectives in the boss panel[/h2]
You start with 4 Subclasses and can unlock the rest by defeating specific bosses at specific levels.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39767884/baad800725f90f88d954b042fbf5aff2ef76d3e0.jpg[/img]


[h2]New minimum card limit for characters[/h2]
Now, your characters have a new minimum number of cards depending of their level. A lot of players complained that a level 4 character with only 5 cards was very strong and usually broke the game, and they had right. This change makes the game harder. 

The new minimum:
Level 0: 5 cards
Level 1: 6 cards
Level 2: 7 cards
Level 3: 8 cards
Level 4: 9 cards


[h2]Tired mechanic has changed[/h2]
Now, the tired mechanic only works in the train. So if your character is tired won´t do more tasks in the train but could go on expedition without any penalties. The reason behind this is simple, you'll be able to play with whichever Subclass you like. 

To compensate this, the game offers rewards for play with another Subclasses. 


[h2]Bug fixing and game balance[/h2]
A lot of bugs has been fixed, and some balance changes has been made. I don't want to make this any longer, I will tell you soon.


[h2]More content soon[/h2]
I want to release another [b]major update[/b] with new bosses, areas, enemies and a lot of things in 2-3 months. And some [b]regular [/b]ones in the middle! Stay tuned!

notes.title: Update 0.6.0.5
notes.content:
Hellow Travelers!

[h3]Some terms translated into [b]French[/b] have been corrected.[/h3]


[h3][b]Azerty[/b] keyboards added in settings![/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39767884/6fe8959e12ad85e0e3acffa9226eb967f75a014a.jpg[/img]


[h3]Now the game is [b]more challenging[/b] than before, I have introduced the following changes for this purpose. In addition, some of the upgrades that players weren't using as much have been buffed:[/h3]


[h3]The [b]Sanity mechanic[/b] has changed; now, in a paranoid state, enemies ambush you, and you lose the first turn. So, it's more dangerous if your sanity drops from a lucid state to paranoid. Before, it was not very relevant, but with this modification, that will change.[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39767884/5d4f7daa216f5cd626f254dd96b10e5ba476aa6f.jpg[/img]

- [b]Terror Strike[/b] damage has been reduced from 75% to 65%.
- [b]Absolute Terror[/b] damage has been increased from 70% to 80%.
- [b]Damage[/b] upgrade has been reduced from 75% to 70%.
- [b]Random Heal[/b] healing has been reduced from 10 to 6.
- [b]Bite[/b] damage has increased from 3 to 4.
- [b]Rage [/b]no longer damages your character.
- [b]Life Stealing[/b] healing has been halved.
- [b]Life Plunderer[/b] damage multiplier has increased from 1.2 to 1.5.
- [b]Might Strength[/b] no longer scales with character power.
- [b]Strength[/b] no longer scales with character power, instead, it has increased from 3 to 4.
- [b]Aces Poker[/b] no longer scales with character power.
- [b]Ninja School[/b] has been reduced as it was the upgrade causing the most imbalance in the game. It had an internal mechanism that made the next result an automatic success after a failure. With this change, that mechanism only activates 25% of the time.
- [b]Steal Armor[/b] no longer scales and has been reduced from 12 to 10.
- [b]Trigger Happy[/b] damage has been reduced from 8 to 6.


[h3]Enemies:[/h3]
- The [b]Crimson Armor[/b] of some enemies has been decreased, some indirect damage builds like Premonition and Trigger-Happy, found a wall in these fights.
- 2nd, 3rd and 5th bosses in Standard difficulty ( level 1) have been decreased their Hit Points in order to remove another possible wall to new players.


[h3]Bug Fixing:[/h3]
- Bugs regarding combat, specially some enemies behavior.
- Bugs regarding exploring.
- Bugs regarding tutorial.


[h3]What´s next: [/h3]
- I´m working on the first [b]major update[/b], it will be ready for the end of the month, you can see it in the [b]roadmap[/b]!

notes.title: Update 0.6.0.4
notes.content:
Hellow Travelers!

notes.title: Early Access Release in a few hours!
notes.content:
Hi Travelers!

[h3]The wait has been long, and the work exhausting, but [b]it's finally here[/b]! Just a few hours left for this train to depart from its station.

The game will go on sale [b]today, the 14th, at 21:00 EDT[/b][/h3]


I've been working hand in hand with the community to improve the game as much as possible. Here are some of the new features you'll find:

[h2]Railmancer Class[/h2] 
The [b]Railmancer [/b]class and their mechanics have been introduced. They can [b]remove cards[/b] from other characters and [b]unlock more slots[/b] to embed additional [b]upgrades[/b].

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39767884/7732ed62e6a6d557f70972484ec855913a108acb.png[/img]

[h2]New Card Feature[/h2] 
My group of testers confirmed that the game was very easy in the early levels. It was very easy to build a god card and break the balance of the game from the start. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39767884/5b35ad6dcf30c96fef6330831f78bfeef8d18652.png[/img]

That's why we've thought of limiting the number of upgrades you can put on a card from the start.

- At [b]level 0[/b], you can have up to [b]2 upgrades[/b] on a card (Railmancer can put [b]3 upgrades[/b] from the start).

- At [b]level 1[/b], you can have up to [b]3 upgrades[/b] on a card.

- At [b]level 2[/b], you can have up to [b]4 upgrades[/b] on a card. ( Railmancer has a limit of 5)

To get it, you have to take your character to the train, to the Railmancer's cabin, so he can unlock it. It's the second carriage you will build, so players will find this very soon.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39767884/acdc1a0f8e55c766b96d40773b96de8f87274a2b.png[/img]

[h2]Remove characters from the train[/h2] 
Now you can dismiss crew members. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39767884/88458c4e00b5aa5a518ebd9c04f3b1a5d88cc7a2.png[/img]

In exchange, newly [b]recruited characters[/b] will arrive on the train [b]tired[/b], unable to perform any [b]tasks[/b], and in need of rest. This change is significant because players could abuse the system by removing a character when they have no energy left and replacing them with another fully rested character. This adjustment has been made to prevent such exploitation.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39767884/da7a74d5d937ff38f6b3131da322b72e46889d93.png[/img]

I've added more changes and improvements that you'll surely enjoy! But it's best for you to [b]discover them yourselves[/b]!

notes.content:
Hello, players!

The Prologue has been open for some time now. Have you been enjoying it?

During this period, we have been actively preparing for the game's EA release. Today, we want to share with you what we've been up to lately.

As you may have noticed, we have added six distinct classes and are working on designing unique models and animations for each one. In the Prologue, you've already met the Soldier and Engineer classes. The Doctor and Scholar will make their appearance in the EA version too:

[h1]New Feature: Power[/h1]

We have introduced the [b]"Power" attribute[/b] - 
Now, [b]all damage and effects[/b] originating from cards and upgrades [b]are directly influenced by the character's Power[/b] stat. You have the opportunity to enhance this attribute at the [b]Workshop[/b] located on the train.
Until this point, distinctions between two characters at different levels were rather minimal. A level 1 character could execute a successful combo and potentially surpass the strength of a level 4 character (the highest attainable level). Presently, however, the level 4 character will typically wield greater power than the level 1 character, regardless of deck quality, given that their Power attribute has been advanced through upgrades aboard the train.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39767884/0f96923436375caf162aec40aebd819b14a4523a.png[/img]


[h1]New Feature: Skip new card/upgrade screen[/h1]

I´ve added a [b]"Skip" option[/b] when receiving card and upgrade rewards - 
During playtesting of the Prologue, many players provided feedback about card choices, feeling that adding new cards not only didn't strengthen the deck but also disrupted their original development plans. In response to your feedback, we have included the "Skip" option.

This is only a [b]test[/b]. [b]I want to know what players think about this change[/b]. Then, I'll decide whether to keep it as it is or make some changes. Another idea I'm thinking about is putting [b]a limit on how often you can use the Skip[/b] option during each journey. This is to make the game fairer, as having a deck with 6 cards full of upgrades can make it really strong. I'll need your feedback to help with this.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39767884/d18cfdf7d4f61e811f97fb8dd67462dfd6136b7d.png[/img]

[h1]You can play these new features in the prologue now![/h1]

That's all the new updates we have for you this time! The announcement of the release date is just around the corner, and the EA release is not too far away. We hope you all are excited and looking forward to it.

Thank you for your continued support!

notes.title: Prologue Release on Friday! The Train Reborn from Darkness
notes.content:
Dear travelers,

We have exciting news about [i][b]Railroads & Catacombs[/b][/i]!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39767884/0ad7deb3951c73951c2be651656bc0ae44ace9e8.png[/img]

After months of refinement, our courageous train, guiding us through thorns and darkness, is about to unveil itself in a new form. We have added numerous new features and are preparing to release the free prologue in a few days, allowing you to experience the game's transformative changes firsthand.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39767884/2f94a0cbefe2431468ecd96f252f92e8662f1c51.png[/img]

In "Railroads & Catacombs", we have completely upgraded the Rogue levels, which were already challenging, and introduced a brand-new gameplay element: the ability to build and gear up your train and recruit crew members!

Moving forward, players will no longer control just a single character but a multi-character team, with each expedition dispatching one team member at a time.

[b]Unique and distinct crew members:[/b] Members bring their own classes and card deck derived from two different combat styles. Each adventure grants individual experience boosts and card enhancements to your men. However, there is a risk of permanent consequences, as team members may get injured and become unfit for battle or even perish.

[b]Collaboration is key:[/b] As different classes determine each member's role on the train. Doctors excel in healing, while Engineers possess construction expertise. With each crew member's unique strengths, only by uniting the power of the team you can survive in this post-apocalyptic world.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39767884/62c7d1cb32668b0462e586afe87f036161c06416.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39767884/23147ffca38bfbbbfcafd7ffebb88f9ee9c43df2.png[/img]

[b]Building Your Train:[/b]

The train serves as the player's unique safe haven in the game, and we want it to be [b]more than just a background setting[/b]. It will have practical functions and special roles.

The train starts as an Engineering Cabin, and players can continuously add [b]different functional carriages[/b]. The Void Portal carriage allows recruiting different team members as companions. The Cabala Library unlocks technology and serves as a prerequisite for upgrading other carriages. The Infirmary Cabin allows doctor crew members to treat the wounded. The Training Room allows members to further enhance their abilities through training. The train will become a valuable asset for your adventures.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39767884/7df8a358b68aa5474d7540eafa9e4a6c53905651.png[/img]

[h2]Here are the specific content updates:[/h2]
[olist]
[*] The 35-level difficulty system has been replaced with the [b]Campaign mode[/b], where bosses have [b]four difficulty levels[/b] for players to challenge, and you can freely select the difficulty for replay. Different difficulties not only involve numerical differences but also introduce more skills and aggression in boss encounters.
[*] The [b]train car construction system[/b] has been modified. After this update, there will be [b]12 diverse train cars[/b] available for construction, each with unique functions. Every car can also be upgraded, including the Engineering Cabin, Void Portal, Recruiting Barracks, Infirmary, Cabala Library, and more. Additional train cars will be released in the future.
[*] The [b]character development system[/b] has undergone significant changes, allowing gameplay with [b]a team composed of multiple characters[/b]. Each character possesses their own classes, combat style, and card deck. Currently, the game features five classes: [b]Soldier, Engineer, Doctor, Scholar, and Psychiatrist[/b]. There are six combat styles can be paired in various combinations with [b]120 different card effects[/b]. We invite you to experience the specific effects and actions in the game. We are also planning a sixth class.
[*] The game has added [b]story elements[/b]. We hope that the combination of text and CG artwork will create a more immersive atmosphere for players. Dynamic camera angles have been implemented during battles to better capture your spectacular moments.
[*] Various bugs have been fixed.
[*] With the release of the prologue, we are getting closer to the official launch. We hope you maintain your excitement, and if you enjoy this game, please consider adding it to your wishlist!
[/olist]

[h2]The prologue includes:[/h2]
[list]
[*] Recruiting team members of different combat styles using the Void Portal to form your exploration vanguard!
[*] Exploring the first and second locations and challenging two unique and eerie bosses!
[*] Experiencing the vital roles played by soldiers and engineers during the journey!
[/list]

After the prologue release, we are one step closer to the early access. We appreciate your continued support. If you would like to engage with us and fellow players, join our Discord channel to stay updated on the latest developments!

Thank you for your attention and enthusiasm. We can't wait to embark on this thrilling journey with you!

Best regards!

notes.title: New Campaign Mode: PART 1/3
notes.content:
Hi travelers! 
[b]Railroads & Catacombs[/b] has a lot of new features, the most interesting is the new campaign mode. After listening to the feedback you have given me I have decided to make some changes in the structure of the game to make it more interesting and deep.

[h3]CAMPAIGN MODE[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39767884/f82bc1bae9c188342727bc055b7cacf26c85425b.jpg[/img]
Now, the only way to play the game is the campaign mode, in which we will have to take command of the Rosalin and its crew. 

[h3]THE ROSALIN[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39767884/d431c0e0903fbe63dc2c41cb4de90a3be6d85110.jpg[/img]
The crew of the Rosalin has been entrusted with a mission, to go into what is known as The Labyrinth, a maze of rails where time and space are twisted in a spiral of madness and horror. His mission is to investigate and discover its secrets.

[h3]THE CREW[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39767884/6e67814072341f34a85ae4e1a8a2e1bddb807477.jpg[/img]
Now you can handle and manage several characters, there are different classes and each one has its own mission in the train, and different features when it comes to exploring and fighting.

[h3]THE ACADEMY[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39767884/da8d44776e67ef1f19cc5d355d3fc1dee58b0108.png[/img]
It could be said that it is the only safe settlement that exists in the world of R&C. No one remembers its foundation, nor when they started sending expeditions to the Labyrinth. Its leaders rule the place with an iron fist, no one escapes their creed.

[h3]The LABYRINTH[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39767884/5bc7fe9da5f9e5132ede2fe0a7e8cbd7cab539d0.jpg[/img]
The Academy knows very little about it, the only certainty is that it keeps growing, its thick fog covers more and more land. Beyond that fog, little is known about what is happening or what remains, since very few have returned. Those lucky enough to return have lost their sanity forever.



[h3]The release[/h3]
These changes and new features are taking me more time than I thought, so I have had to delay the early access release to this summer, and the final game will be released a few months later. I want Railroads & Catacombs to be deeper and its horror atmosphere richer in detail, this is not a simple card game, I want it to be much more. 

But you will be able to test the new features soon in the playtest of the game, I need your feedback to polish it as much as possible. I don't know the exact date yet.

notes.title: Beta Update
notes.content:
[h3]UPDATE NOTES[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39767884/386dc5d3336e80e6af920fcfd0cc9b7491df9e5a.jpg[/img]

SANITY MECHANIC REVAMP
- I have gone deeper into this mechanic to give it a richer playable aspect. Now, there are 3 states of Sanity, Lucid, Paranoid and Hysterical, each giving advantages or disadvantages to combat and exploration.

- Now the number of Stamina points (what you need to use cards in combat) depends on Sanity's status. As you explore this dark world you lose your mind and fear takes over, reducing your ability to respond.

- In a lucid state your character can pick up more information from his environment and is more prepared for a possible combat, this means that you can see more information on your mini-map and surprise the enemy. 

- If your Sanity is very low, your perception of your surroundings will be very poor, you will barely see any information on your mini-map and enemies will surprise and ambush you with ease, losing the first turn of combat.

- In addition, character animations have been added to represent each state, and combat animations have been added to represent each state. The character will now tremble and become nervous as their Sanity drops.

AMBIENT AND SANITY SOUNDS
- Ambient sounds have been added to make the world more believable. Sounds have also been added for each state of Sanity, you can hear the character's breathing speed up as their Sanity drops to the point of hysteria and whimpering in panic.

WOUNDS EFFECTS
- Now you can see the state of wounds of your character, as your life points decrease, wounds will appear on the character's face.


BALANCED CHANGES
- The number of segments in each zone has been adjusted, it is now slightly larger than in the demo version. 

- Adjusted the number of Bones and Wood that you earn after combat and exploration to be a little less.

notes.title: Backgrounds!
notes.content:
[h1][h2]Backgrounds finished![/h2][/h1]

Hellow Travelers!

As you already know, you can [b]immerse yourself[/b] in this dark world with [b]various identities[/b], each representing a [b]past in your life[/b] and a different way of playing, with different [b]advantages and disadvantages[/b]. They are designed with the idea of offering very different gameplay and challenges:



[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39767884/62857c1e4696749f5f55d046b25080bf5c2efa26.jpg[/img]
[h2]ADVENTURER[/h2]
There's no better reason to live than to feel the wind in your face as you cross at full speed over this harsh and rugged land in search of booty and glory. What more could you ask for?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39767884/4867b17b71c784b3d877f87725208df430082dc1.jpg[/img]
[h2]FERVENT[/h2]
Following in the footsteps of the creator has always been your only goal in life, you never needed to understand the Final Conclusion nor did you ever question your faith.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39767884/a4a4570c9589c0debcd347681e3fad799fc0511a.jpg[/img]
[h2]EXPLORER[/h2]
You always wanted to know what's beyond, to go where no one else has been. To cross this dark land in your old train and reach the edge of the world.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39767884/21eeedc62041f709997353fdbd076d6dc260def6.jpg[/img]
[h2]SURVIVOR[/h2]
You have never known what it is like to feel safe, your only goal is to get out of this full of madness cursed land.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39767884/50309ed17cf31cda17c8b47a14e79c70aa3505ef.jpg[/img]
[h2]EXECUTOR[/h2]
When the madness broke out in your city you lost your whole family. Now, thirsty for rage, you have decided to undertake this suicidal expedition. There is only some consolation in the massacre.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39767884/3b5001cd2449be3c7f87b86b8f00195db51847f4.jpg[/img]
[h2]THE COLLECTOR[/h2]
Since you are a child you have seen how your family survived thanks to these incredible steel beasts, the only place where you could feel safe. You decided to dedicate your life to discovering all kinds of artifacts, weapons, tools or technology that would help improve this dangerous lifestyle on rails.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39767884/922a6f65f36b7388e477ae0b9be59a4eab3a89a9.jpg[/img]
[h2]CULTIST[/h2]
The day we began to understand the Final Conclusion of our creator a rampant madness took over everyone, you were one of the few who accepted and embraced it with all your soul, even though now you need more answers, and you will look for them where no one else dares.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39767884/905ee12ef874a2d399fe8c288faf213b95e07d48.jpg[/img]
[h2]HANDICAPPED[/h2]
You were born with malformations that made things very difficult for you, your mental disability didn't help much, yet you always try to do your best.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39767884/284bb85c7ede26f4852269768ce28e33a887715f.jpg[/img]
[h2]STRANGE MAN[/h2]
At birth you were blessed with strange mutations, your wealthy family banished you from their train and condemned you to an inhospitable life on the outside. Thanks to your ability to live between life and death you have been able to make a name for yourself. You will go anywhere to learn more about the terrible affliction you suffer.
